item.title: When You Cannot Bear It Yet
item.description: John 16:1-15 - Jesus prepares His disciples for hardship with compassion, promising that although He is leaving, the Holy Spirit will come to guide, teach, and remain with them. He gives them enough to hold onto now, knowing they cannot bear everything at once, and reminds them that remembering His words will help steady them when hard things come.
